items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the internal frost-fractured valve. Case 25 supports €53 gross for one valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers the connection hose needed with the valve renewal. Case 25 supports €27 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover the labour needed for the fitting repair. Three hours at €95 gross gives €285, consistent with Case 25.
Sections 7.1.7(e) and 3.6(c) distinguish consumables used in the repair from the contractor's own small equipment. Allow €7 for actual repair consumables, consistent with Case 25's ceiling.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance for the covered plumbing work. Case 25 supports €41 gross.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 cover actual use of the camera to locate the leak. Allow €25 for equipment use alone, consistent with Case 25 and below the €2,500 gross event cap.
Section 7.1.11 excludes a second attendance unless agreed in advance, and no approval is stated. The conditional estimate uses the €41 benchmark for one attendance.

items.description: Remove loose and spalled facade plaster
items.rationale: The facade frost endorsement and sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(a) cover stripping failed plaster from the damaged area. Allow two small removal units at €40 each, excluding disposal.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the affected area. Allow €60 for patch materials, without duplicating separately billed labour.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover re-forming the damaged substrate. Allow €125 for the distinct patch reinstatement work, excluding amounts billed for base plaster or painter hours.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover primer required for the original finish system on the damaged area. Allow €35 for one small-area priming item.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying only where needed before reinstatement. Allow €85 for limited drying if necessary and incurred; the invoice does not specify the method or duration.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover only the coats required by the pre-loss finish system on the affected area. Allow €140 for the supported coating materials, with painter labour priced separately.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour attributable to the damaged elevation, not the separately billed rear repaint. Five hours at €65 gross gives €325.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.8 cover necessary access for the damaged elevation; no rear-work apportionment is needed because the scaffold was struck before that work. Allow €650 gross for short-term access across roughly 48 m² of elevation.
Sections 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting a separate undamaged elevation, even for matching. The positive figure is a conditional estimate for one ordinary ladder-access repaint.
Sections 2.6.2 and 5.2.1 cover transport and disposal of debris from the covered facade repair. Allow €55 gross for a few rubble sacks, not a skip.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude a separate administrative charge that prices no repair work. The €15 figure is a conditional estimate only.
Sections 3.6(a) and 7.1.12 exclude subsistence for the contractor's crew. The conditional estimate is three refreshments at €5 each.
